# emptyred: written by build.sh from toys/emptyred.y; do not edit.
level nonassoc LB
level nonassoc HIGH
rule 0 s: VAR opt LB NUM RB
rule 1 s: VAR opt
rule 2 opt: %prec HIGH
rule 3 opt: LB NUM RB
accept	2:1-1,1:0-1	VAR
refuse	-	VAR LB
refuse	-	VAR LB NUM
accept	2:1-1,0:0-4	VAR LB NUM RB
refuse	-	VAR LB NUM RB LB
refuse	-	VAR LB NUM RB LB NUM
refuse	-	VAR LB NUM RB LB NUM RB
